pick.name: Google Search Console + Ahrefs Webmaster Tools
pick.what: GSC for indexing/queries; AWT for site audit, backlinks, keywords of verified sites
pick.why: Both free; AWT adds a 170+-issue site audit and Site Explorer data for your own sites
pick.free_limits: AWT: unlimited verified sites, 5,000 crawl credits/project/mo, 1,000 backlinks/keywords visible

alts.name: Semrush Free
alts.why: Free 10 reports/day for competitor keyword research; paid USD 117/mo annual

decision: Verify every site in GSC and AWT on day one. Use Semrush's free reports for competitor research. Write content with Claude, and use Gemini Deep Research for research briefs.

verify.note: AWT confirmed: unlimited verified sites, 5,000 crawl credits/project/mo, 1,000 backlinks/keywords visible, 170+ issues. Semrush free: 1 project, 10 reports/day (confirmed).
